scenarioHelp.title: Scenario assumptions
scenarioHelp.bear: revenue growth −up to 8pp (minimum 2pp adjustment), FCF margin −up to 6pp (floor 0%) and WACC +2pp (terminal growth −0.5pp). Drivers: weaker execution, margin compression and more expensive capital.
scenarioHelp.base: normalized assumptions based on historical facts (revenue CAGR and normalized FCF margin), with no scenario adjustments. It's the anchor, not a point forecast.
scenarioHelp.bull: growth +up to 8pp (cap 50%), FCF margin +up to 6pp (cap 60%) and WACC −1pp (floor: terminal growth +1pp). Drivers: stronger execution, margin expansion and cheaper capital.
scenarioHelp.note: Spreads adjust to each company's historical volatility (between 2pp and the maximum shown). Each scenario's probability comes from the confidence of the evidence and the historical growth bias, not from the model's opinions.
